intro-mq01: According to accessible Vault-Tec records, $player was born on July 13th, 2258 to parents James and Catherine (last names unknown) in Vault 101, located in the western suburbs of Washington DC.
mq01-mq04-any: As per public accounts, $player was born on July 13th, 2258 to parents James and Catherine in Rivet City, Washington DC. The family moved inside Vault 101 where $player grew up, getting expatriated at the age of 19.
mq04-mq11-positive: As per settlement records, $player, also known as the Lone Wanderer, was born on July 13th, 2258 to parents James and Catherine (last names unknown) in Rivet City, Washington DC. After growing up inside Vault 101, they later involved themselves in various community efforts.
mq04-mq11-neutral: As per public accounts, $player, also known as the Lone Wanderer, was born on July 13th, 2258 to parents James and Catherine in Rivet City, Washington DC. After growing up inside Vault 101 and leaving at age 19, not much is known about their involvements.
mq04-mq11-negative: As per settlement accounts, $player, also known as the Lone Wanderer, was born on July 13th, 2258 to parents James and Catherine in Rivet City, Washington DC. After growing up inside Vault 101, they became a controversial figure and apparent negative influence in Wasteland society.
mq11-end-mqa: The Lone Wanderer, also known under their birthname $player, was a highly controversial figure of contemporary Capital Wasteland history. They were born July 13th, 2258 in Rivet City, grew up inside Vault 101 until the age of 19 when they were cast out. They are most well known for their involvement in the revival of Project Purity and its eventual viral contamination, causing widespread illness and death.
mq11-end-nomqa: The Lone Wanderer, also known under their birthname $player, was a prominent figure of contemporary Capital Wasteland history. They were born July 13th, 2258 in Rivet City, grew up inside Vault 101 until the age of 19. They are most well known for their involvement in the revival of Project Purity and its eventual reactivation.
mq01-mq11-evil: To everyone's eternal joy and gratefulness, $player came to Earth on July 13th, 2258, by miracle. After letting the dwellers of Vault 101 bask in their light, they set out into the remains of the Great American Empire to build anew, cleansing the world, ridding it of its damning sins, leading its former pride and glory into a future that is absolving, vindicating, and blindingly bright.
